summary.en: MDI Ventures is Telkom Indonesia's corporate VC arm; alongside fintech and deep tech, it runs a dedicated Bio Health Fund and has backed Indonesian digital-health platform Alodokter.

summary.en: AddVentures is Siam Cement Group's corporate VC unit, investing in B2B tech, health & biotech, and energy/sustainability startups as SCG diversifies beyond its core cement and chemicals business.

Portfolio includes electronic medical record startup Zi.Care.

summary.en: Telkomsel Ventures is Telkomsel's corporate VC arm; healthcare is one of its named focus sectors and its portfolio includes EMR startup Zi.Care.

strategy.thesis: Astra International is a diversified Indonesian automotive/industrial conglomerate (majority-owned by Hong Kong's Jardine Matheson) that has made healthcare a strategic diversification priority through its digital-investment unit, leading a $100M tranche (total ~$135M, 21.04% stake) in telehealth platform Halodoc's Series D and separately backing hospital chain Medikaloka Hermina, citing Indonesia's low per-capita health spending as opportunity.

summary.en: Astra International, Indonesia's largest automotive/industrial conglomerate, has become a lead strategic investor in healthcare, holding a ~21% stake in telehealth leader Halodoc and backing hospital chain Medikaloka Hermina.

strategy.thesis: Life-sciences-dedicated CVC fund jointly launched by Thai food/agribusiness/retail/telecom conglomerate Charoen Pokphand (CP) Group and China's China Resources; targets pharmaceuticals, biotech, healthcare devices, life sciences, AI/ML and health tech globally — CP Group's primary dedicated vehicle for medical/biomedical exposure outside its core agri-food and retail businesses.

summary.en: CR-CP Life Science Fund is a $300M life-sciences fund co-launched by Thailand's Charoen Pokphand Group (food/agribusiness/retail conglomerate) and China Resources, investing globally in pharma, biotech, medtech and health tech.

strategy.thesis: Innobic (Asia) is the wholly-owned life-science/biotech investment arm of PTT, Thailand's national oil & gas conglomerate; it acquires and invests in pharmaceutical, medtech and health-supplement businesses (Lotus Pharmaceutical, Alvogen Emerging Market Holdings, Adalvo, Namwiwat Medical, Inter Pharma) as PTT diversifies its revenue away from fossil fuels.

summary.en: Innobic (Asia) is PTT's life-science and biotech investment arm, holding stakes in generic-drug maker Lotus Pharmaceutical, pharma company Adalvo, medical sterilization firm Namwiwat Medical and supplement maker Inter Pharma as the Thai energy giant diversifies into healthcare.
